audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Beat Drop as matchup-defining with no cooldown digit (packet also flags no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere), and breakdown.trading is a generic template with no Seraphine-specific mechanic. Neither uses the auto-reset tell from missingInteractions (Stage Presence casts twice on every 3rd spell — a real wind-up tell) or the Surround Sound sustain angle.
audit.why: Seraphine's W Beat Drop... actually her E Beat Drop-equivalent (root, listed as enemyAbilities.E Curse... no — for Seraphine the root is E) is down for 11s at rank1 down to 9s at rank5, so naming the number gives a real wait-for-X cue. Her passive Stage Presence casting twice on the 3rd spell is a visible tell before her burst lands, and Surround Sound (W) heals on repeat casts, so trading into an already-up W loses the sustain race.
